headline: Kuura Strand Cleared While Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse Hemorrhage
war_summary: Since the mid-afternoon dispatch, Colonial forces have swept the remainder of Kuura Strand, extinguishing the lingering Warden foothold to claim full mastery over all six sector bases. Across the northern front, combat has turned savage along the Nevish Line, where ferocious see-saw engagements at Princefal and Blackcoat Way drove casualties above eighteen hundred within two hours while maintaining a tense six-to-two Warden distribution. Even heavier devastation wracks the Weathered Expanse; four strategic outposts now lie pulverized in neutral ruins amid blistering gunfire around Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, leaving Colonials holding three strongholds to the Wardens' two. In Dead Lands, a sudden resurgence in Warden attacks produced over twelve hundred casualties in the past hour alone against fortified Colonial positions. Conversely, the tempestuous clash in Callahan’s Passage has abruptly cooled, casualty rates dropping sharply with Warden control intact. Further east, Marban Hollow and the Linn of Mercy continue to simmer with escalating skirmishes along their splintered borders, though strategic lines held without fresh changes over the latest watch.
